I rewrote `message.md`; no other files were changed. It now reads:

> The export scheduled for 14:00 UTC has been delayed and will be ready by 16:00 UTC. Your existing data is unaffected, and we'll send you an email as soon as the export is ready.

All four facts are still there: the original 14:00 UTC time, the new 16:00 UTC time, that existing data is unaffected, and that an email will go out when the export is ready. I removed the all-caps "THIS IS A DELAY, DO NOT PANIC" line and let the calm wording reassure readers instead.
